title: Course – Tokyo Marathon
claims: The Tokyo Marathon course starts at the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building in Shinjuku.
The official course map shows a 42.195 km course through central Tokyo.
The official course page publishes an elevation profile and course map.
The official course map shows central Tokyo landmarks including Tokyo Tower, Asakusa Kaminarimon and Ginza.
The official course page currently presents the 2027 course; this entity pins the 2026 edition shown in the linked 2026 course map.
